Scheduled job wrapper for `send_resident_digests.R`. Deploy and schedule
*this file* on Posit Connect Cloud (Friday 3pm) — not
`resident_weekly_digest.qmd` directly, which just renders one blank
report with no recipients when Connect re-runs it on a schedule. The
rendered HTML here is a log of the run, not a deliverable; the real work
(render each resident's digest + POST to Power Automate) happens as a
side effect of the chunk below.

Required Connect environment variables on this content item: `RDM_TOKEN`,
`REDCAP_URL`, `DIGEST_APP_URL`, `POWER_AUTOMATE_RESIDENT_URL`.

```{r}
source("send_resident_digests.R")
```
